deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Can ping an IP but not a URL.
note: Check DNS servers, flush the cache, query a public resolver to compare.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Host has 169.254.x.x.
note: Check link, switch port VLAN, ip helper-address, scope exhaustion, DHCP service.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Can reach the local LAN but nothing outside.
note: Gateway wrong = nothing remote. Mask wrong = partial local failures too.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Can reach some hosts on the local LAN but not others.
note: The host is misjudging which destinations are local.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Server answers ping but the app will not connect.
note: Check the service is listening, then test the port, then the host firewall.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Port test says connection refused.
note: The network path is fine. The service is down or bound to the wrong interface.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Port test times out.
answer: A firewall or ACL is silently dropping it
note: Refused = nothing listening. Timeout = something is dropping.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: New firewall rule added but traffic is still blocked.
note: ACLs are top-down, first match wins. An earlier deny is catching it.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Two devices have intermittent connectivity and sessions drop.
note: arp -a shows a flapping binding; show mac-address-table finds the port.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Whole network slows, switch CPUs at 100%, all LEDs blink together.
note: Break the loop physically. Prevent with BPDU Guard on access ports.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Floor went down right after a user tidied their desk.
answer: Both ends of a patch cable in two wall jacks
note: A loop. BPDU Guard prevents this entire class of problem.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Workstation links at 100 Mbps on a gigabit switch.
note: Gigabit needs all four pairs; it falls back rather than failing.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Terrible throughput with late collisions and CRC errors.
note: One side hardcoded, the other autonegotiating down to half.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Interface shows rising CRC errors.
note: Bad cable, EMI, distance, failing transceiver, or duplex mismatch.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Interface shows rising discards but no errors.
note: Frames were fine; the queue was full. Add capacity or apply QoS.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Small pings work but large transfers hang.
note: Path MTU Discovery cannot signal back, so the connection black-holes.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: New fiber link stays down at both ends.
note: Swap one end. Then check for transceiver mismatch.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: New AP will not power on though the port has link.
answer: PoE budget exhausted or wrong PoE standard
note: Check show power inline. Wi-Fi 6 APs usually need PoE+ or better.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Switch port keeps going err-disabled.
answer: A violation — port security, BPDU Guard, or link flap
note: Read the log for which. Fix the cause before bouncing the port.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Port died after a user swapped laptops.
note: A sticky MAC entry recorded the old laptop as the only allowed device.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: New VLAN works on one switch but nowhere else.
note: Also check the VLAN exists on both switches and has an SVI and DHCP scope.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: New subnet reaches the server; the server cannot reply.
note: Routing must exist in both directions.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Guest network: existing devices fine, new ones get nothing.
note: Shorten the lease time first, then widen the scope.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Some clients get correct addressing, others get a strange range.
note: ipconfig /all names the issuing server. Fix with DHCP snooping.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Addressing works but no names resolve anywhere on the subnet.
note: Option 3 is gateway, 6 is DNS, 66/67 are PXE boot.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: VoIP call connects and rings, but one side hears nothing.
note: SIP signaling worked. The audio uses separate dynamic UDP ports.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: VoIP audio is choppy and robotic.
note: Variation in latency. Fix with QoS and a priority queue for voice.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Users lost the network — half the office only.
note: One switch, uplink, VLAN, DHCP scope or controller. Do not start at a PC.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Everything is slow at the same time every day.
note: Backups, imaging, replication. Find it with flow data, then reschedule or shape it.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: VPN connects but no internal resources are reachable.
answer: Routes, split tunnel scope, or firewall rules
note: Connection succeeded, so credentials and the tunnel are not the issue.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Certificate warning on a site that worked yesterday.
note: Everyone affected = expiry. One machine affected = its clock or trust store.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Domain logins suddenly fail site-wide with no changes.
note: Kerberos rejects tickets outside about five minutes of skew.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Traceroute shows the same two routers repeating.
note: TTL kills the packets. Check the routing table on both routers.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Tunnel is up between two offices but no traffic passes.
note: Each host thinks the remote address is local. Renumber or NAT.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: New connections fail intermittently; existing ones are fine.
note: Add public addresses or shorten translation timeouts.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Wi-Fi drops while walking between areas.
note: Check RSSI at the failure point. Strong signal points at roaming, not coverage.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Strong Wi-Fi signal but unusable when the room is full.
note: More APs with smaller cells. Raising transmit power makes it worse.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Printer works, then stops, then works after a reboot.
note: Fix with a DHCP reservation, not a static address inside the scope.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: High traffic, healthy spanning tree, lots of multicast.
note: Enable IGMP snooping. Not a loop.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Switch floods all traffic out every port.
note: Mitigate with port security limiting MACs per port.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Downloads are fast, uploads crawl on a broadband circuit.
note: Cable and DSL are asymmetric by design. Check the contracted rates.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Fast link, high latency, no loss, but one transfer is slow.
note: Parallel transfers filling the link confirms it. Needs window scaling.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: Storage throughput collapsed after enabling jumbo frames.
note: Switches still at 1500 drop the oversized frames as giants.

deck: N+ Quick · Common Errors and Fixes
front: One website is down for everyone; everything else works.
note: Test from cellular, check DNS, and check your own content filter.
